card.title: IPhone 15 Series - No Touch/No Charging

claims.statement: iPhone 15 series losing charge (often plus touch) after cheap USB-C accessories usually has a damaged U9500 USB-C controller and/or its paired EEPROM U9720.
Replace both as a matched pair from a same-model donor; solder U9720 first, then U9500. Locations differ by model and US/international variant.

procedure: Test with genuine Apple cable/adapter; inspect port.
Rule out flex/battery on a known-good board.
Replace U9720 then U9500 from same-model donor.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
